title.narrative: Provision of integrated lifesaving health services to the flood-affected population in Berdale district of Bay region

description.narrative: ltpgtThe humanitarian needs in Somalia continue to grow following substantial rainfall over the last one month triggering devastating floods, causing deaths and displacement, swamping farmlands, and damaging roads, bridges, and airstrips, thereby restricting access to towns and settlements for displaced people. Heavy rains resulting in flash floods as well as riverine floods have currently affected over 1.4 million people and displaced nearly half a million people, and these are expected to rise as more rainfall and flooding is recorded in the country.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe proposed project will support 2 static, 3 mobile centers, 9 ORP Centres and 1 CTC Centre in the Berdale district. New-Ways plans to deliver an integrated package of promotive, preventive, and curative maternal, newborn child health services and scale-up outbreak early warning and response and case management of epidemic-prone diseases through the mobile response team as part of the efforts to support the flood-affected communities in Berdale. The project aims to scale up the static and mobile clinics in Berdale IDP and host community sites and scale up the health care through skilled health professionals. New-Ways through this project will provide regular medical supplies and life-saving drugs to established health facilities, establish referral mechanisms and improve the coverage of measles vaccinations, and support safe motherhood and reproductive health while also ensuring readiness to prevent and respond to outbreaks such as malaria, measles or AWD/Cholera and promote health update through health education and beneficiary sensitization including management of rape and GBV. The project will engages the PLWD, minority groups and women and girls by ensuring representation, allow access, direct engagement, collaborate, train and engage them as staff and beneficiariesltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe activities to be undertaken will include:ltbrgtProvide Outpatient consultations to flood-affected IDPs in Berdale districtltbrgtProvide routine and campaign immunization to under 5 children and TT to Women of Child Bearing Age (WBCA)ltbrgtEnsure the treatment of common diseases such as pneumonia, diarrhea/dehydration, malaria, and skin conditionsltbrgtProvide antenatal and post-natal care to pregnant and lactating mothers at the 2 static and the 3 Mobile sites.ltbrgtMaintain and continue the services being provided at the 2 static and the 3 mobile sitesltbrgtConduct a community mobilization and awareness-raising workshop at the start of the project for 100 peopleltbrgtConstruct and furnish 3 outreach shelters with materials for the mobile sites such as forms, tables, chairs.ltbrgtProcure Medical supplies and ensure that the 5 facilities have enough supplies throughout the project period.ltbrgtProvision of quality multi-sectoral services (clinical case management, PSS, justice, safety)ltbrgtConduct quarterly supervision every 3 months for two quartersltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtTraining of staff and CHWs on IMCI, BeMONC, MHPSS, CMR and AWD/Cholera prevention and infection controllt/pgtltpgtProvision of PPE to staff and CHWslt/pgtltpgtEstablishment of CTC/CTUlt/pgtltpgtEstablishment of ORP/ORT Cornerlt/pgtltpgtProvision of ORT/ORP materials to ORP centrelt/pgtltpgtSocial behaviors' communication for community engagementlt/pgtltpgtDistribution of IEC materials and billboardslt/pgt
